system.name: U2UData+
system.one_liner: A large swarm-UAV autonomous flight dataset for embodied long-horizon tasks plus a scalable online collection and closed-loop verification platform.

content.reading_order: Starts at the red ribbon over the mosaic at top centre, then moves to the top-left Simulator card and the top-right UAV card, and last along the bottom row of three cards.

layout.arrangement_note: Top row: a dashed card, the wide hero mosaic with its ribbon in the middle, a dashed card. Bottom row: three dashed cards. Every card has a dark slate title tab on its top edge, a pale green fill, one or two pictures and a bold sentence under them. No arrows join the cards.

encoding.color_means: Slate title tabs, dashed frames and statements, pale green card fill and a red ribbon for the dataset name; blue arrows mark the flow of data into the terrain and the order of task phases; colours inside pictures are content.
encoding.line_style_means: Dashed frames = one card per scalable component.
encoding.shape_means: Title tab on a card edge = component name; notched red ribbon = dataset name; small blue block arrow = source to result or next phase.
encoding.marker_means: No numbering; callout labels name HUD fields, view types and sensor positions; an axis key (X, Y, Z, upward, downward) sits inside the UAV picture.
encoding.emphasis: The red ribbon over the largest picture block, the central mosaic of real frames.

lessons.what_to_learn: For a dataset-plus-platform paper, put a branded hero mosaic of real samples in the middle and surround it with capability cards, each with a title tab, one picture and a single sentence that says what scales.
lessons.suits: Dataset or platform papers whose contribution is a set of scalable capabilities and who have many real renders or screenshots to show.

evidence: supporting the customization of simulators, UAVs, sensors, flight algorithms, formation modes, and ELH tasks
Through a visual control window, U2UData+ allows users to collect customized datasets through one-click deployment online
all UAVs are equipped with 5 RGBD cameras (front, back, left, right, and bottom), a 64-LiDAR sensor (top)

summary: U2UData+ is a large dataset of swarm-UAV autonomous flights for embodied long-horizon tasks, with a platform for collecting data online and verifying algorithms in closed loop. Figure 1 is a poster-like composite: a red ribbon with the name crowns a mosaic of ten simulated forest frames, framed by five dashed pale-green cards with dark title tabs. Each card pairs a picture with one bold sentence about what scales: an annotated simulator screenshot with HUD fields and four sensor views, a UAV render with sensor positions, a Yunnan map and a weather-centre logo feeding a terrain render, two rows of task-phase frames, and a control-window screenshot beside a formation-mode sketch.
summary_zh: U2UData+ 是面向具身长时程任务的集群无人机自主飞行数据集，并配有在线采集与闭环验证平台。图像海报：红色横幅下是十张模拟森林画面，周围五张虚线卡片分别展示可扩展的模拟器、无人机与传感器、真实地图、任务和飞行算法。
notes: The index calls the figure diagram/mechanism; it is a capability-card mosaic. The ten mosaic tiles are one composite bitmap in the SVG (the digest counts 14 bitmaps in all), so picture counts are visual tile counts. The source of the Yunnan map picture is not stated.
